{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Recognizable, competent race scene: four horses, jockeys, grandstand, tote board, sun, clouds, and finish line are all clear. Shapes are well-formed; modest simplification keeps it from being exceptional."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 5, "reason": "Every hard requirement met: standalone valid SVG, 1200x800 viewBox, no external assets or scripts, four distinct horses translating left-to-right at different speeds toward the finish, plus waving flags, dust puffs, changing tote board, and drifting clouds."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Inventive touches: tote-board odds that change over time, photo-finish beam camera, multicolor waving flags, dust puffs behind hooves, and dotted crowd. Fits the brief without feeling generic."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Horses genuinely translate across the track toward the finish line and loop; legs cycle through gallop poses, hooves kick up dust, flags wave, and tote-board odds update. Motion works as intended."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 4, "reason": "Layered gradients for sky, turf, grandstand, and rails; drop-shadow and blur filters; dotted crowd; sun glow; track markings; finish-line pole. Rich and detailed throughout."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Balanced elevated side view: grandstand upper-left, tote board and sun upper-right, track and horses below, finish-line pole at right. Harmonious colors and clear depth layering."},
  "summary": "A complete, lively animated horse-race SVG that meets every hard requirement with convincing motion and rich, layered detail."
}
